mapper.select: SELECT FROM today_placement WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM today_placement WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND source_kind=#{kind} AND source_id=#{sourceId}
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT generation FROM today_plan_generation WHERE owner_id=#{owner}),0)

SELECT CASE WHEN #{kind}='TRAINING_SESSION' THEN (SELECT started_at FROM training_session WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{sourceId}) ELSE NULL END AS training_started_at, CASE WHEN #{kind}='REVIEW_ACTION' THEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM review_action_source s JOIN review_repractice_source b ON b.owner_id=s.owner_id AND b.source_id=s.id JOIN review_repractice r ON r.owner_id=b.owner_id AND r.id=b.repractice_id JOIN training_session t ON t.owner_id=r.owner_id AND t.id=r.session_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.action_id=#{sourceId} AND s.tracking='TRACKING' AND t.started_at IS NOT NULL ) ELSE FALSE END AS action_started, CASE WHEN #{kind}='PREPARATION_TASK' THEN (SELECT updated_at FROM preparation_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{sourceId}) WHEN #{kind}='REVIEW_ACTION' THEN (SELECT updated_at FROM review_action WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{sourceId}) ELSE NULL END AS source_updated_at
SELECT revision,snapshot_json FROM today_placement_history WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND placement_id=#{id} AND revision < #{before} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO today_plan_generation (owner_id,generation,updated_at) VALUES (#{owner},0,#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_id=today_plan_generation.owner_id
mapper.update: UPDATE today_plan_generation SET generation=generation+1,updated_at=GREATEST(updated_at,#{now}) WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND generation=#{expected} AND generation < 9007199254740991
mapper.select: SELECT owner_id,local_date,zone_id,revision,available_minutes,created_at,updated_at FROM today_day_budget WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND local_date=#{localDate} AND zone_id=#{zoneId}
mapper.update: UPDATE today_day_budget SET revision=#{value.revision},available_minutes=#{value.availableMinutes},updated_at=#{value.updatedAt} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND local_date=#{value.localDate} AND zone_id=#{value.zoneId} AND revision=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT revision,snapshot_json FROM today_day_budget_history WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND local_date=#{localDate} AND zone_id=#{zoneId} AND revision < #{before} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT #{limit}
